Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama! Was it a car or a cat I saw? Never odd or even. Did Hannah see Hannah? A Toyota's a Toyota. No lemon, no melon. Racecar! Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam. Was it a rat I saw? Step on no pets. Able was I ere I saw Elba.
